messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate observed for tenant=kestrel on dedicated pool `dedicated-kestrel-01` (15% 5xx over 5m), latency p95 spiking. Severity=P2. Paging on-call.
sam-oncall: I'm on pager — looking. Any recent deploys to that pool?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: canary-id=canary-20260315-9f3 targeting 20% of traffic for dedicated-kestrel-01. Artifact: rdw-model:v3-canary-sha45c7
sam-oncall: OK that matches timeframe. Pulling logs and tailing model-worker stderr.
rajesh-eng: I see repeated OOM traces and kv-cache errors in the canary workers. New quantization layer in v3-canary changes KV layout.
sam-oncall: %5xxs are mostly model runtime errors (OOM / kv mismatch). Looks tenant-scoped — only Kestrel traffic affected.
lia-cs: Kestrel-support, heads-up: we are seeing errors for your requests, investigating. Will update in a few mins. @kestrel-support
mike-platform: If it's tenant-scoped we can do a targeted pinback for just that tenant rather than full rollback. Suggest isolating tenant and routing them to pinned artifact v3-stable-sha1a2b.
sam-oncall: Agree. Prefer surgical pinback: route Kestrel back to pinned artifact, keep canary for other tenants. Steps?
rajesh-eng: Steps I recommend:
1) Set tenant routing override to pinned artifact.
2) Drain/evict canary workers for tenant=kestrel.
3) Restart model workers for tenant to ensure fresh KV cache.
4) Monitor 5xxs and latency.
mike-platform: Commands (will run with redwoodctl):
```
redwoodctl routing override set --tenant=kestrel --pool=dedicated-kestrel-01 --model=rdw-model:v3-stable-sha1a2b
redwoodctl pool evict --pool=dedicated-kestrel-01 --model=rdw-model:v3-canary-sha45c7 --tenant=kestrel
kubectl -n dedicated-kestrel rollout restart ds/model-worker -l tenant=kestrel
```
sam-oncall: Running override now.
mike-platform: override applied: tenant=kestrel -> rdw-model:v3-stable-sha1a2b. Deploy bot should reflect zero traffic to canary for that tenant.
deploy-bot: Traffic weights updated: dedicated-kestrel-01: canary=0% (tenant=kestrel), stable=100% (tenant=kestrel)
ops-bot: Eviction queued for tenant=kestrel on model rdw-model:v3-canary-sha45c7. ETA ~30s.
sam-oncall: Restarting workers for tenant to clear old KV caches.
rajesh-eng: Watch for transient errors during restart — some in-flight requests may fail. We'll suppress alerts for a 2m maintenance window.
sam-oncall: Suppressing alerting for tenant=kestrel, window=2m (reason: targeted pinback).
lia-cs: Messaging to customer: "we isolated your traffic and routed it back to the previous verified artifact while we investigate. Minimal interruption expected, more updates soon." @kestrel-support
kestrel-support: Thanks — confirm we'll see reduced errors, please share ETA for full resolution.
sam-oncall: Eviction done, workers restarted. Watching metrics.
rajesh-eng: Logs show OOMs cease for restarted workers. Errors dropping.
mike-platform: Metrics: 5xx rate for tenant=kestrel down from 15% -> 0.8% in the last 2m. p95 latency back to baseline.
sam-oncall: Nice. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Keeping canary paused for Kestrel until eng sign-off.
rajesh-eng: Root cause looks like quantization + KV layout change in v3-canary; caches warmed with old layout cause runtime failures for tenant-specific cached items. We need a cache-migration or avoid layout change in canary for dedicated pools.
tia-sre: I'm taking this incident for post-mortem and follow-up. @sam-oncall handing off on-call. Sam, anything outstanding?
sam-oncall: Handoff done — logs and command history in /var/log/incidents/1799003210. No ongoing degradation. I'll be available if anything spikes.
tia-sre: Acknowledged. Lia, please confirm customer comms and follow-up with an incident summary.
lia-cs: Will send summary: what we did, ETA for RCA, and next steps. Offer a follow-up call if they want.
kestrel-support: Appreciate the quick fix. Please include when canary will be reattempted and whether we need any action on our side.
rajesh-eng: We'll plan a canary rollback plan: either a cache migration step or rebase canary quantization. We'll postpone any further canary attempts on dedicated-kestrel-01 until confirmed.
tia-sre: Setting incident status -> mitigated. Scheduling a post-mortem review for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Owners: rajesh-eng (root cause), mike-platform (rollback playbook update), lia-cs (customer comms).
ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-1799003210 updated: status=mitigated, severity=P2, owner=tia-sre
tia-sre: Closing handoff. If metrics stay stable for 2h we'll resolve; otherwise reopen.
lia-cs: Sent customer note; will share thread with them once PM review is done.
kestrel-support: Thanks — we'll wait for the RCA. No further impact on our side now.
tia-sre: Incident thread closed to active paging. Post-mortem link will be posted here after draft.
sam-oncall: Back to standby.
